title: Delay Goodwill Credit for Held-Up Customer-Pay Repairs (Rental Vehicle Coordination)
content:
**Desk guidance.** Under Rental Vehicle Coordination, when a customer asks for amends because the network customer-pay repair the rental is tied to was held up, the desk offers a delay goodwill credit that names the rental's time charge; the customer accepts it on the rental, and it is booked as a goodwill credit.

A goodwill credit for lost rental days is not fixed until the repair-customer discount owed on the time charge stands against it.

The goodwill credit for lost rental days is fixed only after every young-renter fee the renter owes on the rental stands as a charge on it.

## Business effect

| Element | Content |
|---|---|
| Request it answers | A customer's request for amends because the network customer-pay repair the rental is tied to was held up |
| Who offers and who accepts | The desk offers the credit; the customer accepts it on their own rental |
| What the credit names | The rental's time charge entry |
| Observable effect | A customer credit with reason goodwill, dated the day it is accepted, appears in the rental's day and money history naming the time charge; the renter's outstanding share falls by the amount accepted |

## Acceptance tool: `accept_rental_goodwill_credit_52804ea3`

**Capability.** Lets the renter accept, on their own rental, the goodwill credit the desk has offered against one of the rental's customer charges. Accepting books the credit: a customer credit with reason `goodwill`, dated today, naming the charge it reduces, appears in the rental's day and money history and the renter's outstanding share falls by the amount accepted.

**How it is invoked.** This tool belongs to the customer: the desk unlocks `accept_rental_goodwill_credit_52804ea3` and hands it over, and the customer themselves runs it to accept the credit on their rental.

**Parameters.**

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `rental_reservation_id` | Reference number of the renter's rental reservation, as read out by the desk from the rental reservation lookup | Id |
| `source_entry_id` | Reference number of the customer charge the goodwill credit reduces, as read out by the desk from the rental day and money history lookup | Id |
| `amount_usd` | Goodwill amount accepted | USD, 2 decimal places, positive; rounded half-up to the cent when booked |

**Return.** A receipt with `status` ("accepted" when the credit was booked), `rental_entry_id` (reference number of the new credit entry), `rental_reservation_id` (the reservation credited), `source_entry_id` (the charge the credit names), `credit_reason` (always "goodwill"), `amount_usd` (the amount credited, USD with 2 decimal places) and `entry_date` (booking date, YYYY-MM-DD).

## Contract illustration (hypothetical)

When the customer themselves runs the tool with their reservation reference, the time charge entry the desk read out and 35.00, the receipt reads `status` "accepted", `credit_reason` "goodwill" and `amount_usd` 35.0.
